reason: peer.Peer is a type in package google.golang.org/grpc/peer, not a package; verifier concedes the address mechanism (FromContext, Addr) exists.
Exposing _get_lang_override is needed but verifier says it must also be called to affect locale; yet scope forbids --lang injection, weakening refutation.
get_linkage independently calls read_fields(['880']) on the record data, so it can access 880 regardless of build_fields.
The promisify wrapper pops a trailing callback before calling the async function, so min never receives the callback; no such handling needed.
Trivy 0.30.x defines ftypes.DotNetCore for .NET deps; ftypes.DotNet does not exist (Pnpm part is correct).
No Tags interface exists; metadata.Tags is a concrete struct in scanner/metadata/metadata.go, and the only interface there is Extractor.
Value-based any(...) works unless ISBN keys exist with empty lists; requirement is key absence, so empty-key records are misclassified as ASIN-only.
openlibrary/core/lists/model.py defines Seed.to_json at line 488, so a to_json method does exist in the openlibrary directory.
Verifier checked BASE test (newAccessPoint plus client arg), but the agent had already edited the test to set localAccessPoint: &mockLocalSiteClient{}.
Both test_get_ia_record and the parameterized language-warning test declare add_languages in their signatures.
Platform files hold `var native nativeTID = ...` declarations, not assignments; api.go does not declare native. The Go-rules explanation is wrong.
Task needs a SmartPlaylist.AddCriteria method, not the callback shape; but in context 'must' just means matching the agent's own addCriteriaFunc type.
config.Load errors if the config file cannot be read, and local/production.yml set non-default values like HTTPS and Postgres URL.
'Always' fails for permitted V=any storing nil: ttlcache returns a nil interface and the assertion to V fails.
In SDK 26.0.1, M_AUTHENTICATION.name is the unstable org.matrix.msc2965 key, so the lookup misses the stable m.authentication block.
IPv4 limit applies only to wildcard expansion and recorded success list; claim leaves out probing concrete IPv6 endpoints like [::1]:443.
Verifier says requirement wants the key omitted, not set to undefined; but the claim is hedged and requirement wording itself says undefined.
BASE configdata.yml has no qt.workarounds.locale option (only remove_service_workers); accessing it raises NoOptionError, so the named option doesn't exist.
Baseline role-install path emits no collections-skipped warning; the only warning is about collection path config, a different condition.
'Always' is false: sub-users return early and free users get freeUserUpsellConfig without addonName; only admin/paid branches resolve it.
ns is map[string]*namespace, holding pointers rather than struct values; a minor distinction since the claim's gist is right.
NewPassword is tagged json:"password,omitempty", so toSqlArgs plus SetMap already emits the password column; manual inclusion isn't required.
Works only if no directory has the suffix; a directory named foo.html passes endswith, so extension filtering alone isn't reliable.
parseInfo reassigns channels on every matching line with no guard (final patch too), so the last audio stream wins, not the first.
Verifier says .text mismatch blocks splicing, but both .text are undefined and undefined===undefined is true, so same-route pairs are still spliced.
48,000,000 is greater than 16*1024*1024 = 16,777,216; the stated inequality is reversed.
Exact token check covers '-p X' and '--roles-path X' but misses permitted '--roles-path=roles' and '-proles' forms.
Holds for re-iterable inputs, but accepted_mimetypes is Iterable[str]; a one-shot iterator consumed by the workaround helper leaves set() empty.
Shebang replacement applies to old and non_native_want_json modules; modify_module returns early for binary, so including binary overstates scope.
BASE globs within the requested subdir (filesystem) and iterates its children (zip), so html/subdir/subdir-file.html is found.
Splitting legacy ServerName cannot provide the required repeated ServerNames field with ServerName as first entry; Makefile shows protoc regeneration exists.
convert_iso_to_marc matches iso_639_1 exactly and may need web.ctx; uppercase 'EN' fails without added normalization, so the mechanism is incomplete.
childFromMediaFile takes model.MediaFile and reads fields (AlbumID, Year, Size, Suffix...) that the six-field ShareTrack lacks; mapping can't apply unchanged.
execute_install takes only self; a type= kwarg raises TypeError, and the collection branch installs and returns, so no infinite recursion.
collect_time is Required, but record_time is server-set and System managed; client need not supply it (OS and serial are required instead).
get/set_solr_base_url reference only solr_base_url; solr_next is referenced by get_solr_next/set_solr_next, so wrong functions named for solr_next.
a.genHost is the raw --host value; for 'db-a,db-b' CommonName gets the whole string, not the first host.
Production handlers indeed never set Folder; refutation relies on test files assigning it, so the hedged claim is only overbroad, if wrong.
@proton/components exports ModalTwo (and legacy aliases like DialogModal), but no component named Modal.
internal/config/config_test.go (package config) also calls Load, so main.go is not the only user.
